result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, crates/rmcp/tests/test_task.rs gives end-to-end test evidence for request capability gating. TaskServer::call_tool derives client_supports_tasks from RequestContext::client_capabilities(); a tasks-declaring client receives CreateTaskResult, a plain client receives the synchronous sum result, and a separate dispatch test rejects a handler-produced task result for a non-declaring client with MISSING_REQUIRED_CLIENT_CAPABILITY. This strengthens the prior handler-example finding with executable test coverage of both positive and negative capability paths.
source_scope: Own clean state, sanitized root/control identities, own role config, and one exact-commit public repository test file only.
